cli.intro: open-ssh — remote host manager with transport adapters. Non-interactive CLI for agents and humans.

cmd.capabilities: Report the capability matrix and per-transport support
cmd.audit: Read audit records for the current actor
cmd.gui: Open the VMZ GUI window and pump host events until it closes
cmd.connect: Connect to a target and establish a session
cmd.exec: Execute a command and return stdout, stderr, and the exit code
cmd.session: Enumerate sessions and report their state
cmd.port-forward: Configure local, remote, and dynamic port forwarding
cmd.key-management: Generate, import, protect, and inspect host keys
cmd.known-hosts: Verify host keys and update known hosts entries
cmd.host-install: Install the host integration and desktop entry
cmd.host-uninstall: Remove the host integration and clean residual state

opt.actor: Audit actor id (user or agent name)
opt.transport: Transport adapter to use. Support is reported per capability
opt.dry-run: Plan only, do not touch host state
opt.kind: Filter audit records by actor kind
opt.id: Filter audit records by actor id
opt.capability: Filter audit records by capability id
opt.from-ms: Filter audit records from this Unix timestamp in milliseconds
opt.to-ms: Filter audit records up to this Unix timestamp in milliseconds
opt.content-dir: Directory containing the staged GUI build
opt.command: Command to run on the remote host
opt.identity: Path to an unencrypted ssh-ed25519 private key
opt.password-env: Name of the environment variable holding the remote password
opt.host-key-sha256: Pinned server host key fingerprint in SHA256: notation
opt.timeout-ms: Connection and handshake deadline in milliseconds (default 30000)
